articles.title: The Music We Can't Stop Playing This Year (So Far!)
articles.summary: Imagine a song that feels like a secret door to another world. NPR’s music team picked 24 albums and songs they love most in 2026, from Kacey Musgraves’ country fun to a Korean band’s dream lab. There’s something weird and wonderful for everyone!

articles.title: Hear Music Through Your Cheekbones? These Headphones Are Magic!
articles.summary: Imagine listening to your favorite song while still hearing the world around you—no earbuds needed! Bone conduction headphones send sound through your cheekbones. WIRED tested the best ones for 2026, from swim-proof Shokz to a Suunto model that fights wind noise. Your ears will thank you.

articles.title: Can One Swimmer Be the Best at Everything? Fans Debate!
articles.summary: Kate Douglass broke the world record in the super-fast 50-meter freestyle—but she’s also a champion in the 200-meter breaststroke! That’s like being the fastest sprinter and the best long-distance runner. Fans voted: is she the most versatile female swimmer on the planet?
